tess_cs: Anchorage Freight (contact: pullan@anchoragefreight) pinged about onboarding a bespoke manifest anonymizer. Wants Private (customer VPC) + HSM, masking (not deletion), and p95 <= 300ms. Asking for eval plan and renewal impact. Who can own?
omar_se: I can take SE. Quick facts needed: framework/size, QPS, and whether they permit hashed telemetry.
tess_cs: Pullan: PyTorch 2.0, ~5B trimmed model, realtime single-row queries, QPS ~12, hashed telemetry ok under NDA. They need an NDA addendum for logs and no persistent token storage.
nidhi_safety: Safety Qs: enumerate sensitive fields (names, shipper_id, customs_ref, phone). Need adversarial redaction probes plus extraction accuracy checks. Propose FNR target <1% for high-severity fields.
callie_pm: Product note: ephemeral KV cache only, will require infra sign-off for Dedicated if we can't meet latency in Private VPC. That will affect renewal/commercial. Tagging @ryan_sales.
infra_bot: infra-bot created ticket CS-9801 "anchorage manifest anonymizer" https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/CS-9801 :white_check_mark:
omar_se: Ops asks: please provide ~400 anonymized rows + schema. Example perf cmd once data arrives:
```
./perf_eval --model anchorage.pt --data samples.jsonl --qps 12 --concurrency 4 --quantize int8 --ephemeral-kv --out results.json
```
ETA 48-72h after samples.
ryan_sales: I'll prep pricing scenarios for Dedicated + HSM surcharge. If they need reserved capacity that's a renewal leverage point.
tess_cs: I'll request data + NDA addendum now and schedule a tech sync for Tue 9am PT. Will update CS-9801 when samples land. :thumbsup:
